context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on event budgeting
purpose: Teach: 引か/運ば/塗り/桁/タスク/パブリック/フィードバック/会費

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、桁を間違えて大目玉食ったよ。
lines.en: When I was younger, I miscalculated a figure and got dressed down for it.
lines.style: Lean back slightly, measured tone. Light dry humor — not bitter. Pause after 'figure' like he's letting the memory settle. Quiet confidence that mistakes teach.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 肝に銘じます。タスクの優先順位、再点検します。
lines.en: I'll take that to heart. I'm going to double-check the task priorities.
lines.style: Sit up straighter. Voice steady and clear but not rehearsed. Direct eye contact. Genuine commitment — no deflection, no over-apologizing. Simple and sincere.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: パブリック向けの広報、注目を引かない案は意味がない。
lines.en: Public-facing PR — a campaign that doesn't capture attention is pointless.
lines.style: Slower tempo, measured breath. Each phrase deliberate. Not lecturing but teaching. Eyes level. The weight of experience without the weight of judgment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい、内部フィードバックを多めに集めます。
lines.en: Yes — I'll gather more feedback from the internal team.
lines.style: Quick nod in the voice. Alert but not anxious. Respect without deference. Short, clean phrasing. Shows he's already thinking ahead to the next step.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 会費収入だけに頼らず、スポンサーも運ばせろ。塗り絵のように手堅く準備するんだ。
lines.en: Don't lean on membership fees alone. Bring sponsors into the picture too. Prepare everything methodically, piece by piece.
lines.style: Firmer now. This is the real wisdom. Slight emphasis on 'don't rely on' — not harsh, but certain. Slow, deliberate pacing. Each sentence lands. Ends on solid ground.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet, respectful close. Single beat of acknowledgment. The younger man has heard him. Slight nod in the voice — not dismissal, but closure.
